title: The Seventh Hammer
summary: Face the Seventh Hammer in the chamber of judgment.
overview: Face the Seventh Hammer in the chamber of judgment.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: The Seventh Hammer offers a challenge through its judgment dialogue. Assemble the group before accepting.
When the Tribunal cycle is active, the encounter alternates judgments on a seventy-five-second timer after its opening warning.
Keep healing ready for repeated area pressure and defeat the Hammer before leaving the chamber.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.

Confirm the intended Tribunal timer behavior before publication: the ready dialogue sets dialogue=true, while the combat handler starts the judgment timer only when dialogue is false. The dialogue-triggered fight may omit that cycle.
